punchline: In Wickman's system a ten-year vision only becomes real when it lands as one job on one person's desk this quarter.
thirty_sec: Gino Wickman's Traction breaks vision into a ladder: a ten-year target, a three-year picture, a one-year plan and quarterly goals called Rocks. Each quarter the team narrows its list to about seven and gives each one a single owner. One summary tells of a company that dropped its computer-networking division to return to simplifying printing for clients. That is how the far goal becomes this week's work.
